title: The Five Heartbeats
about: The rise and fall of a 1960s vocal group, told through friendship, fame and family.
cue: Serve the mains when the group sits down to Sunday dinner with Duck's family.
faces: EVERY NIGHT, A TABLE FOR YOU
“We stay a family, not a group. Family eats together, so pull up a chair.”
Crispy baked wings tossed in honey and hot sauce butter.
Eggs with mustard, sweet relish and hot sauce, dusted with smoked paprika.
Macaroni baked with cheddar, evaporated milk and egg, golden on top.
Sunday fried chicken with ham hock greens
Dense buttery lemon pound cake with fresh lemon zest.
Lemonade with lime, cherry syrup and crushed ice, topped with a cherry.

Two drink minimum at the stage tables. Cover charge after nine. No discussing the Five Heartbeats' matching suits at the tables. Card No. 5. Showtime: Serve the mains when the group sits down to Sunday dinner with Duck's family.
